design_guidance.owner_quote: in this case, especially on defense, you should not be thinking about strictly how the duelist’s space revolves around the team’s utility, that is more suited for attacking when you need to execute a site.
design_guidance.scope: Stated about one defensive round; treated as a design principle pending more cases.

design_guidance.owner_quote: using the flash/drive to clear b main, then within 3 seconds using the dart and paranoia combination to overwhelm site as mwzera dashes in on their execute is a perfect example of util synergy on a site execute, while keeping the time between initially showing their positions (with the flash/drive to clear the first b main line) and the main part of the site execute (paranoia and recon bolt) down to just 3 seconds not giving the defenders enough time to rotate (there already were a large number of NRG players B, they had a good read but that’s not Furia’s fault)
design_guidance.scope: One execute. Three seconds is the owner's description of this sequence.

design_guidance.owner_quote: I dont know if the event stream covers where the util was thrown or in what direction, but try to also account for the distance between pieces of util and how that affects how a team’s space control ends up. ex: in this example, marved smoked tree, then havoc used his zero point and flash drive to fight out of that exact smoke and reclear tree, forcing the attackers back out of tree and back into mid, and giving furia information on where the attackers are and being forced to go. this was a significant example of trading utility for space and information in a midround setting.
design_guidance.feed_answer: The event stream does not record where utility was thrown, its direction, or where it landed. A cast event carries the caster's own position.
design_guidance.scope: Owner request. Only the spacing between casters is measurable in this export.

design_decisions.question: How long before an attacker's entry should a smoke or molly still count as supporting it? Flashes and recon stay at the 3 seconds described for Ascent R13.
design_decisions.effect: Vision-block and damage casts count for 5 seconds; vision-impair and recon casts for 3.

design_decisions.question: Combination utility means smokes and walls, flashes and blinds, recon, and damage. Which changes do you want, if any?
design_decisions.owner_selection: Keep the four as they are (Recommended)
design_decisions.effect: Suppression and detain are not added. Sensors and traps stay excluded. Spycam still counts as recon.

design_decisions.question: Which casts should mark an attacker's entry?
design_decisions.effect: Only Tailwind and Updraft mark an entry. Shrouded Step and From the Shadows do not.
design_decisions.note: No option was recommended. In this series one player per team casts these two abilities.

design_decisions.question: In Ascent R13 the feed records mwzera's Tailwind at 15.116s, but his largest position jump is between 20.667s and 21.349s. From the VOD, what does the 15.116s event mark?
design_decisions.effect: Entry timing is measured from the Tailwind activation. The dash time is not in the feed.
design_decisions.note: No option was recommended. This is the owner's observation from the VOD of one round.
design_decisions.option_text: He primed Tailwind at about 15s and dashed later. Support timing measured from the event would then be early by however long he held it.

design_decisions.question: Should defender utility after the plant get its own channel?
design_decisions.effect: No retake channel. Post-plant defender casts remain in the defender combination channels.

design_decisions.question: The defender answer channel counts defender utility cast within 10 seconds after an attacker smoke or wall, using timing only. What should happen to it?
design_decisions.effect: The answer family keeps its 10-second lookback and is a later experiment arm.

design_decisions.question: 16 of the 555 scored windows come after every attacker is dead with the spike planted. How should evaluation treat them?
design_decisions.effect: The 555-window dataset is unchanged. Each metric is reported for all windows and for the 539 with a living attacker.

design_decisions.question: Should 'how far a player moved between two distant snapshots' become a rotation feature?
